messages:
maria: Quick sync — I want to capture a compact checklist for integrating FlashAttention v2 -> v3 in runtime. Focus areas: kernel selection heuristics, batching interaction, KV cache behavior, and what perf probes we need. Low-ceremony thread to collect owners and concrete checks.

devin: +1. main risk we saw in preliminary benches: perf regressions at long seqs (>=4096) when kernel heuristic prefers v3 in some layouts. need reproducible profile steps.

jordan: Can we standardize the profiling cmd? I suggest: 
```
./bench_attn --model t5-3b --seq 4096 --bs 1 --kernel-candidate flashv2,flashv3 --device a100
```
Capture p99 token latency, throughput, and L2/GPU utilization.

lee: Also include KV cache cold vs warm runs. KV miss ratio metric is crucial: when cache misses spike v3 seems to do more GPU memcpy. Add: run with prefix caching warmup of 8 batches and then measure.

rachel: Note that fused-MHA fallback path differs between v2/v3 which can change memory usage. Add memsnap: 
```
nvidia-smi dmon -s u -o DT -f memsnap.log 1
```
Compare RSS and peak allocation.

maria: Good. For heuristic gating propose feature-flag: `attn_kernel_selector=auto_v3_experimental` that defaults to off. Canary plan: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% with automated rollback on quality/perf alerts.

devin: Telemetry to emit per-request: kernel_choice, kernel_latency_ms, kv_miss_ratio, seq_len_bucket (<=512,512-2048,2048-4096,>4096), batch_size. Also attach model_id and quant profile.

jordan: Add a small smoke test script in runtime repo: `tools/attn_smoke.sh` that runs the bench cmd and fails if p99 increases >8% vs baseline. Baseline artifacts stored in perf-bucket.

lee: Ops checklist for rollout: 
- staged AMI build with both kernels
- deploy canary pool (tag: flash-v3-canary)
- enable flag for canary nodes only
- gather perf traces for 24h
- run regression detector job
- flip flag to 25% if green

rachel: For KV-specific tests: create synthetic trace with long-history contexts; measure KV cache hit-time and eviction churn. Example config: `seq=2048, prefix=8192, kv_window=4096`. We'll compare cache hit latency between kernels.

maria: Ownership: 
- profiling & bench harness: @devin
- infra canaries + AMI: @jordan
- rollout automation + flags: @lee
- KV traces + model regressions: @rachel
- doc + checklist: me (maria)

devin: One more: add microbench for micro-batching effect. v3 microkernel seems sensitive to small batch aggregation. Script idea: sweep batch sizes [1,2,4,8] and record per-token cost.

jordan: We should also record kernel selection logs in debug mode: `kernel_choice_debug=true` prints why heuristic picked kernel (seq, bs, quant). Helps reproduce nondeterministic picks.

lee: On rollback criteria list: p99 latency delta >10% sustained for 15m, error rate increase >0.5%, memory OOMs, or cost/token > 20%

maria: I'll draft the PR template for the rollout that enforces these checks. Quick follow-ups: can everyone post one perf artifact (bench output, flamegraph, or memory snapshot) into the perf channel by EOD tomorrow?

deploy-bot: NOTE: Scheduled canary pool creation job queued (job id cj-3882). Will report once pools are ready.

rachel: I'll upload a KV trace generator and a small notebook with comparison plots. Putting in `eng-runtime/perf-artifacts/flashv2-v3-kv/`.

devin: Uploaded initial bench CSV to perf-bucket: `s3://redwood-perf/flash-v2v3/2334500000-devin.csv` - contains seq sweep and raw GPU timers.

maria: perfect. thanks all — i'll turn this into a checklist doc and link the PR template.

jordan: tagging oncall: @lee when canaries spin up please monitor the kernel_choice telemetry for noisy churn.

lee: will do. monitoring dashboard query: `sum:rate(kernel_choice{kernel=\"flashv3\",env=\"canary\"}[5m]) by (seq_len_bucket)`

maria: End of thread — action items assigned. We'll sync in tomorrow standup for blockers.
